PART 1The big picture — full state machine

One diagram. Every state. Every transition. Every approval gate.

┌────────────────────────────┐ [ Decision Queue ] │ [ Renewal Trigger ] │ │ │ contract clock fires │ │ user clicks "Open decision" │ 90 / 60 / 30 day notice │ ▼ └──────────────┬─────────────┘ [ /source/new — INTAKE ] │ │ │ │ 5 facts captured ▼ │ POST /api/v1/source/events [ Renewal event opens ] │ lifecycle_state = waiting_on_client │ ▼ │ [ /source/events/[id]/approval ] ← NEW PAGE — currently missing │ │ │ │ approver reviews 5 facts + chat trail │ │ options: APPROVE / REQUEST CHANGES / SEND TO CO-APPROVER │ │ │ ├─ → co-approver path → back here when ready │ │ │ │ POST approve · lifecycle_state = active │ ▼ │ [ /source/events/[id]?stage=strategy ] ← stage 1 unlocked │ │ │ │ draft memo · clear gate 1 (3 hard criteria) │ ▼ │ [ stage=scope ] ← gate 2 (boundary, exclusions, sponsor sign-off) │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=rfp ] ← gate 3 (RFP locked, vendor list, comms protocol) │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=responses ] ← compliance + completeness │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=evaluation ] ← scorecard authored + dissent captured │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=pricing ] ← TCO normalized + iceberg verified │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=bafo ] ← question pack + round log + concession ledger │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=executive_decision ] ← approval gate · co-signers required │ │ │ │ approver(s) sign decision brief │ ▼ │ [ stage=selection ] ← award record + contract handoff │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=transition ] ← KT plan + go-live readiness │ │ │ ▼ │ [ stage=value ] ← baseline locked → realized savings rolling │ │ │ │ CFO attestation captured │ ▼ │ [ lifecycle_state = closed ] │ │ │ │ contract clock starts │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ (renewal cycle every 12-36 months)
Architectural insight · The current product has 4 missing transitions: (1) intake → approval is silent (no dedicated page), (2) executive_decision → selection has no enforced co-sign moment, (3) transition has no go-live readiness gate, (4) value has no CFO attestation moment. All four are required by the CXO testing bar.

What happens next:
→ On approve: event unlocks at Stage 1 Strategy. You can draft the strategy memo.
→ On co-approve: Lynne gets a notification + this page link. Both must approve.
→ On request changes: chat reopens at /source/new with current facts loaded.
→ On reject: event closed, audit log retains the record.
Design notes · Approval is a real page with its own URL. Approver sees all 5 facts + can expand the chat trail. Co-approver routing is a first-class action. Rationale is required (no silent approvals). What-happens-next preview prevents confusion. Page blocks the canvas — typing the canvas URL redirects here.
